Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human tyrosine-protein kinase JAK1 (CHEMBL2835) in Homo sapiens. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL2835 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require canonical_smiles via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
